prompt: To MOVE a halogen from one carbon to an adjacent one (e.g., 2-bromopentane → 3-bromopentane), you can use:

options.label: Elimination (strong base, E2) to the alkene, then addition of HBr with peroxides (anti-Markovnikov) or without (Markovnikov) to install the Br on the new carbon

explanation: A classic synthesis motif: eliminate to get rid of the FG → add it back on a different carbon. For halide migration: E2 to alkene, then HBr addition. Choice of peroxide-vs-not controls regio (M vs anti-M). Similar logic moves double bonds (add then eliminate differently).
